claims.claim: tile plus lane reconstructs every 64-bit key
distinct keys cannot share tile and lane
eligible keys exclude fallback and reserved high bits
distinct lanes have distinct word/mask addresses
Set reads back every full-width result
Set increments logical size iff key was absent

scope: Machine-checked bitvector/one-key transition model. Translation to Go, Go map/array behavior, memory safety, concurrency, compiler key equivalence, semantic integration, and performance are not proved. Go differential histories independently test the supplied implementation.
